gameDescriptionHtml:
Be One of the 20 with EA SPORTS F1 24, the official video game of the 2024 FIA Formula One World Championship. Unleash your champion in pursuit of a legacy-defining F1 Career, the mode’s first major update since 2016. Drive like the greatest and feel at one with the car through the all-new EA SPORTS Dynamic Handling System. Ignite your passion by connecting to your favorite teams and drivers while proving that you have what it takes across new modes and experiences.

DRIVER CAREER MODE – Unleash Your Champion and Discover the all-new Driver Career mode with new gameplay rooted in the sport or team up with a friend in two-player career.
EA SPORTS DYNAMIC HANDLING – Get to grips with more authentic handling. The latest physics gives you more control over how your personal driving style impacts your car’s performance and race strategy.
CHALLENGE CAREER – A new, interactive feature in the F1 season that offers episodic competitive play with unique events and challenges, allows community members to compete for high scores, and invites them to influence future content by voting on social media and the EA SPORTS Racenet companion app.
FAN ZONES – Ignite Your Passion with Fan Zones these allow you to support your favorite team and driver, collaborate with other fans to achieve goals, raise your profile in the standings, and unlock unique rewards and items.

Game Features

  • RAY TRACING – Dive further into your F1 journey with Ray Traced visuals now offered in Race.
  • CUSTOM GRAPHIC SETTINGS – Maximize your F1 experience.
  • EYE TRACKING SUPPORT – Enhance your driving performance through eye tracking and become one with your F1 Car.
  • EXTENSIVE CONTROLLER SUPPORT – Use your controllers, wheels, pedals, and personalized hardware.
  • HIGHLIGHTS & REPLAYS – Save complete replays of your finest moments, share them with friends, and export Reels to video files.
  • CUSTOM RACE SETUPS – Discover and download balanced Grand Prix setups from the community via the Steam workshop.
  • VIRTUAL REALITY – Exclusive to PC, experience the race’s intensity first-hand from within the cockpit.

Included DLCs (only offline components):

  • Champions Upgrade
  • Pre-Order Starter Pack
  • Champions Bumper Pack
  • Champions Icons Pack
  • Champions Pre-Order Pack
  • Champions Icons Pack
  • F1 25 Pre-Order Livery Pack
